userDefinedCodeListEntries.entryDescription: Credentials entitled at the listed places without a right of their own (service vehicles, exempt plates); a match counts as compliant where enforced.
Credentials whose arrival the operator wants to know about; a match raises watchListArrival where alertOnArrival.
Credentials with unpaid notices or a standing refusal from the list owner; a match raises scofflawArrival and, where refuseService, refuses service at the lane.
The list owner's own enforcement and service vehicles, whose visits are recorded but never enforced or screened.
